record.question: When a bipolar junction transistor is operating in the saturation mode, which one of the following statements is true about the state of its collector-base (CB) and the base-emitter (BE) junctions?
options: The CB junctions is forward biased and the BE junction is reverse biased
The CB junctions is reverse biased and the BE junction is forward biased
Both the CB and BE junctions are forward biased
Both the CB and BE junctions are reverse biased
